title: Deferral of application requirements.
bodyText: For good cause, the commissioner may defer specific application requirements until the filing of an application for a charter or license.
bodyHtml: §412:3-203  Deferral of application requirements.  For good cause, the commissioner may defer specific application requirements until the filing of an application for a charter or license. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1; am L 2006, c 228, §17]
